messages.text: What are the most important signal generation capabilities for applications in AI?

The passages do not support a ranked “most important” list for AI signal generation; they support a capability-based answer: AI/data-center evidence emphasizes high-speed electrical/optical connectivity, while R&S signal-generator evidence emphasizes wideband RF/vector generation, ARB and real-time waveform generation, multichannel MIMO/fading, clean signal quality, digital I/Q, and noise/envelope-tracking functions [46][3][47][13][19][53][52].
| Capability area | Supported answer |
|---|---|
| High-speed electrical / optical data signals for AI infrastructure | AI/data-center connectivity passages identify high-speed electrical interconnect, optical interconnect, fiber deployment, rack power, cooling and leak detection as part of the AI/data-center portfolio, with examples including high-speed signal transmission from ASIC packages to endpoints, OSFP assemblies up to 224G/lane PAM4 and 1.6T aggregate bandwidth, 224 Gb/s PAM4 mezzanine connectors, and XPO-LPO at 224 Gb/s per lane across 64 channels for AI scale-up deployments [46][3][47]. |
| Wide RF frequency range and wide modulation bandwidth | R&S SMM100A supports 100 kHz to 44 GHz, up to 2 GHz internal RF modulation bandwidth, 5G NR FR1/FR2 signal generation, internal real-time signal generation, ARB and custom digital modulation [13]. |
| High-end wideband / multichannel generation | R&S SMW200A RF path A covers 100 kHz up to 67 GHz depending on option, supports up to 8 signal sources, up to 64 fading channels and up to 8 RF paths via SGT100A modules, and supports up to 2 GHz internal baseband I/Q modulation bandwidth in RF [19]. |
| ARB memory, sample rate and RF bandwidth | R&S SMW200A wideband baseband ARB supports waveform length up to 2 Gsample with R&S®SMW-K515, sample rate up to 2400 MHz with R&S®SMW-K527, and RF bandwidth up to 2000 MHz [76]. |
| Standards waveform generation | R&S SMW200A supports internal digital standards including 5G New Radio, LTE up to Release 15, NB-IoT, eMTC, 3GPP FDD/HSPA/HSPA+, GSM/EDGE, WLAN IEEE 802.11a/b/g/n/j/p/ac/ax/be/ad/ay and DVB-S2/DVB-S2X [19]. |
| MIMO and fading emulation | R&S SMW200A can include an integrated fading section with channel emulation bandwidth up to 800 MHz, up to 4 fading modules, up to 64 logical faders, and single-box MIMO fading scenarios including 2x2, 3x3, 4x4, 8x4, 4x8 and 2x4x4 [19]. |
| Clean signal quality | R&S SMM100A is described as having excellent SSB phase noise, EVM and ACPR/ACLR performance, while R&S SMW200A standard performance SSB phase noise at 1 GHz and 20 kHz offset is specified as < –134 dBc, typ. –140 dBc [13][78]. |
| Digital I/Q connectivity | R&S SMCV100B with R&S®SMCVB-K19 provides digital baseband input/output using Dig. I/Q HS compliant with R&S®Digital I/Q interface 40G, with QSFP+/QSFP 28 connector, LVDS level, digital baseband output sample rate up to 300 MHz with R&S®SMCVB-K523, and digital baseband input sample rate from 400 Hz to 300 MHz [53]. |
| Noise, interference and PA-related signal functions | R&S SMCV100B has an AWGN baseband enhancement option R&S®SMCVB-K62, while R&S SMM100A lists envelope tracking among its capabilities, and MWC infrastructure material describes measurement-driven development of energy-saving amplifiers using an envelope signal generated in real time with a VSG + VSA + software turnkey solution [52][13][37]. |
【推論】If “AI applications” means AI/data-center infrastructure, the supported priority is not generic RF signal generation but generation or handling of very high-speed electrical/optical data signals for AI-scale connectivity, because the AI/data-center passages explicitly focus on high-speed electrical interconnect, optical interconnect and AI scale-up deployments [46][3][47].
【推論】If “AI applications” means wireless infrastructure or device test involving AI-era radios, the supported signal-generation priorities are wide RF/modulation bandwidth, ARB/real-time standards waveforms, multichannel MIMO/fading, low phase noise/EVM performance, digital I/Q, AWGN and envelope-tracking support, because those are the capabilities listed for R&S signal-generation and radio-test products [13][19][76][78][53][52].

Data center full-spectrum connectivity › 使用限制
- [[full-spectrum-data-center-connectivity-brochure]] 未標示正式日期；所有產品能力、規格數字與 marketing claim 需標示來源日期缺口。
- 來源是供應商 brochure，不是第三方市場報告；不可用來推論市占率、排名、客戶導入、採購關係或出貨量。
- 來源未提供 datasheet 版次、order number、合規證書或測試條件；224G、448G、1.6T、300G、60A、+54V、60 contacts、0.6mm pitch 等數字只能作為來源文字摘錄。
- PDF 轉檔為 lossy derivative；欄位串接與 OCR 風險需回看原始 PDF。

Data center full-spectrum connectivity › 與既有概念的關係
- [[Data center server 高速互連產品組合]] 偏向 data center server interconnect portfolio 的分類表；[[Data center full-spectrum connectivity]] 更強調 full-spectrum：electrical interconnect + optical + fiber + power + cooling。
- [[Compute tray component solutions]] 偏向 compute tray connectors、cables、power connector、busbar 與 backplane interconnect；本頁納入 optical transceiver、CPO、fiber deployment 與 liquid cooling。
- [[高速伺服器儲存互連]] 可連接本頁中的 [[Mini Cool Edge IO]]、[[Cool Express Link]]、[[Direct Attached Copper Cables]]、[[PCIe CEM 7 Connectors]] 與 storage / EDSFF 類產品。
- [[CPO]]、[[Optical I-O]]、[[Near-Packaged Optics]] 可連接本頁的 [[Amphenol Co-packaged Optics]] 與 [[LEAP On-Board Transceiver]]，但本來源不是技術標準或市場採用證據。

Data center full-spectrum connectivity › High-speed electrical connectivity
- [[Amphenol OverPass Cable Systems]] — 來源稱其 enable high-speed signal transmission from ASIC packages to end-points across the system。
- [[ExtremePort OSFP Connectors]] — 來源稱 connectors and cages have 60 contacts per port、0.6 mm pitch，並 optimized for signal integrity、thermal management and multi-lane pluggable architecture。
- [[Amphenol XtremePass]] — 來源稱 XtremePass 448G connector solution supports scalable form factors from 32DP to 128DP，並跨 Ethernet、NVLink、PCIe、InfiniBand systems。
- [[OSFP Cable Assemblies]] — 來源稱 OSFP cable assemblies compatible with 25G/lane NRZ up to 224G/lane PAM4，deliver aggregate bandwidths of 200G、400G、800G and 1.6T per cable assembly，available in Passive and Active variants。
- [[Sentry HD High-Speed Backplane Connector]] — 來源稱其是 next-generation high-speed backplane connector platform。
- [[Celerity 224 Gb-s BGA Mezzanine Connectors]] — 來源稱其 designed to support data rates up to 224 Gb/s PAM4。

R&S SMCV100B › 適用條件與規格定義
依 [[SMCV100B_specs_en_3608-0627-22_v1700]]，產品資料適用條件：

- 在 ambient temperature 儲存 `3 小時` 後，warm-up operation `30 分鐘`。
- 符合指定 environmental conditions。
- 遵守 recommended calibration interval。
- 已執行所有適用的 internal automatic adjustments。

規格定義：

The passages do not support a ranked “most important” list for AI signal generation; they support a capability-based answer: AI/data-center evidence emphasizes high-speed electrical/optical connectivity, while R&S signal-generator evidence emphasizes wideband RF/vector generation, ARB and real-time waveform generation, multichannel MIMO/fading, clean signal quality, digital I/Q, and noise/envelope-tracking functions [46][3][47][13][19][53][52].
| Capability area | Supported answer |
|---|---|
| High-speed electrical / optical data signals for AI infrastructure | AI/data-center connectivity passages identify high-speed electrical interconnect, optical interconnect, fiber deployment, rack power, cooling and leak detection as part of the AI/data-center portfolio, with examples including high-speed signal transmission from ASIC packages to endpoints, OSFP assemblies up to 224G/lane PAM4 and 1.6T aggregate bandwidth, 224 Gb/s PAM4 mezzanine connectors, and XPO-LPO at 224 Gb/s per lane across 64 channels for AI scale-up deployments [46][3][47]. |
| Wide RF frequency range and wide modulation bandwidth | R&S SMM100A supports 100 kHz to 44 GHz, up to 2 GHz internal RF modulation bandwidth, 5G NR FR1/FR2 signal generation, internal real-time signal generation, ARB and custom digital modulation [13]. |
| High-end wideband / multichannel generation | R&S SMW200A RF path A covers 100 kHz up to 67 GHz depending on option, supports up to 8 signal sources, up to 64 fading channels and up to 8 RF paths via SGT100A modules, and supports up to 2 GHz internal baseband I/Q modulation bandwidth in RF [19]. |
| ARB memory, sample rate and RF bandwidth | R&S SMW200A wideband baseband ARB supports waveform length up to 2 Gsample with R&S®SMW-K515, sample rate up to 2400 MHz with R&S®SMW-K527, and RF bandwidth up to 2000 MHz [76]. |
| Standards waveform generation | R&S SMW200A supports internal digital standards including 5G New Radio, LTE up to Release 15, NB-IoT, eMTC, 3GPP FDD/HSPA/HSPA+, GSM/EDGE, WLAN IEEE 802.11a/b/g/n/j/p/ac/ax/be/ad/ay and DVB-S2/DVB-S2X [19]. |
| MIMO and fading emulation | R&S SMW200A can include an integrated fading section with channel emulation bandwidth up to 800 MHz, up to 4 fading modules, up to 64 logical faders, and single-box MIMO fading scenarios including 2x2, 3x3, 4x4, 8x4, 4x8 and 2x4x4 [19]. |
| Clean signal quality | R&S SMM100A is described as having excellent SSB phase noise, EVM and ACPR/ACLR performance, while R&S SMW200A standard performance SSB phase noise at 1 GHz and 20 kHz offset is specified as < –134 dBc, typ. –140 dBc [13][78]. |
| Digital I/Q connectivity | R&S SMCV100B with R&S®SMCVB-K19 provides digital baseband input/output using Dig. I/Q HS compliant with R&S®Digital I/Q interface 40G, with QSFP+/QSFP 28 connector, LVDS level, digital baseband output sample rate up to 300 MHz with R&S®SMCVB-K523, and digital baseband input sample rate from 400 Hz to 300 MHz [53]. |
| Noise, interference and PA-related signal functions | R&S SMCV100B has an AWGN baseband enhancement option R&S®SMCVB-K62, while R&S SMM100A lists envelope tracking among its capabilities, and MWC infrastructure material describes measurement-driven development of energy-saving amplifiers using an envelope signal generated in real time with a VSG + VSA + software turnkey solution [52][13][37]. |
【推論】If “AI applications” means AI/data-center infrastructure, the supported priority is not generic RF signal generation but generation or handling of very high-speed electrical/optical data signals for AI-scale connectivity, because the AI/data-center passages explicitly focus on high-speed electrical interconnect, optical interconnect and AI scale-up deployments [46][3][47].
【推論】If “AI applications” means wireless infrastructure or device test involving AI-era radios, the supported signal-generation priorities are wide RF/modulation bandwidth, ARB/real-time standards waveforms, multichannel MIMO/fading, low phase noise/EVM performance, digital I/Q, AWGN and envelope-tracking support, because those are the capabilities listed for R&S signal-generation and radio-test products [13][19][76][78][53][52].

Data center full-spectrum connectivity › High-speed electrical connectivity
- [[Amphenol OverPass Cable Systems]] — 來源稱其 enable high-speed signal transmission from ASIC packages to end-points across the system。
- [[ExtremePort OSFP Connectors]] — 來源稱 connectors and cages have 60 contacts per port、0.6 mm pitch，並 optimized for signal integrity、thermal management and multi-lane pluggable architecture。
- [[Amphenol XtremePass]] — 來源稱 XtremePass 448G connector solution supports scalable form factors from 32DP to 128DP，並跨 Ethernet、NVLink、PCIe、InfiniBand systems。
- [[OSFP Cable Assemblies]] — 來源稱 OSFP cable assemblies compatible with 25G/lane NRZ up to 224G/lane PAM4，deliver aggregate bandwidths of 200G、400G、800G and 1.6T per cable assembly，available in Passive and Active variants。

- [[Celerity 224 Gb-s BGA Mezzanine Connectors]] — 來源稱其 designed to support data rates up to 224 Gb/s PAM4。

R&S SMM100A › 定位與用途
依 [[SMM100A_specs_en_3608-7680-22_v3100]]，[[R&S SMM100A]] 的主要能力包含：

- Frequency range：`100 kHz to 44 GHz`。
- High output power：up to `+18 dBm`。
- Internal RF modulation bandwidth：up to `2 GHz`。
- 支援 5G NR signal generation for FR1 and FR2。
- RF frequency 與 modulation bandwidth 用於 future WLAN requirements。
- Excellent SSB phase noise、EVM、ACPR/ACLR performance。
- Internal real-time signal generation。
- Arbitrary waveform generator。
- Custom digital modulation。
- Keycode extendable bandwidth and ARB memory。
- Timed licenses、waveform packs、floating licenses。
- Structured GUI、touchscreen、block diagram operation、graphical signal monitoring in real time。
- Context-sensitive help system 與 SCPI recording。
- `R&S®SMM-K544` frequency response correction。
- Envelope tracking。
- High rate pulse（HRP）ultrawideband（UWB）。

依 [[R&S for JIO Project]]，[[R&S SMM100A]] 在 [[R&S WoMT 測試方案]] 中被簡報列為 RX sensitivity and blocking tests 的 signal source；但該簡報的 67 GHz frequency range 主張不得覆蓋正式 specifications。

SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100 › 重點摘要
- 來源是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 `R&S®SMW200A Vector Signal Generator Specifications`，文件資訊 `PD 3606.8037.22`，`Version 31.00`，日期 `May 2026`，頁尾另標 `May 2026 (ch)`。
- 本文件補齊 [[R&S SMW200A]] 的 performance specifications；既有 [[SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600]] 是 `Version 06.00`（`May 2024`）configuration guide，偏向配置規則、retrofitting 與 ordering information。
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 的 RF path A frequency options 覆蓋 `100 kHz to 3/6/7.5/12.75/20/31.8/40/44/56/67 GHz`；RF path B 可選 `100 kHz to 3/6/7.5/12.75/20/31.8/44 GHz`。
- 架構可從 single-path [[Vector signal generator]] 擴充到 multichannel [[MIMO]] receiver tester；來源說明支援最多 `8` 個 signal sources、最多 `64` 個 fading channels，以及最多 `8` 條 RF paths（透過連接 [[R&S SGT100A]] signal generator modules）。
- 最多可在 `2` 個 internal baseband modules 上配置 `8` 個 baseband generators，具 real-time coder 與 ARB；可對 baseband signals 做 internal digital adding，包含 frequency offset 與 level offset。
- Standard baseband section 使用 `R&S®SMW-B13` 或 `R&S®SMW-B13T`，RF modulation bandwidth 最高 `160 MHz`；wideband baseband section 使用 `R&S®SMW-B13XT`，RF modulation bandwidth 最高 `2 GHz`。
- Internal baseband I/Q modulation bandwidth in RF 最高 `2 GHz`；2 GHz bandwidth 內 modulation frequency response 為 `< 0.4 dB measured`。
- 支援 internal digital standards，例如 `5G New Radio`、`LTE up to Release 15`、`NB-IoT`、`eMTC`、`3GPP FDD/HSPA/HSPA+`、`GSM/EDGE/EDGE Evolution`、`WLAN IEEE 802.11a/b/g/n/j/p/ac/ax/be/ad/ay`、`DVB-S2/DVB-S2X`；來源同時另列 waveform packages for signals from [[R&S WinIQSIM2]]，其中 [[R&S WinIQSIM2]] requires an external PC。
- 可選 integrated fading section，channel emulation bandwidth 最高 `800 MHz`；最多可安裝 `4` 個 fading modules，提供最多 `64` 個 logical faders；單機可實作 `2x2`、`3x3`、`4x4`、`8x4`、`4x8`、`2x4x4` 等 MIMO fading scenarios。

MWC2025---WIC-INFRA › Digital Design & Power / Energy saving
- Slide 14–15 將 highspeed digital and power designs 定位為需要快速、可靠、準確 T&M tools 的 verification / debugging 領域，測試工具包括 [[VNA]]、probes、phase noise analyzer、power supplies、multimeter、oscilloscopes、signal source。
- Slide 16 說 rising energy costs drive MNOs to boost efficiency，base stations and components offer substantial energy-saving potential。
- Slide 17 提出 optimization of power consumption、power statistics over time、device activity versus power consumption、real-time power / voltage / current statistics、up to 800 W / up to four channels；產品包括 [[R&S NGP800]]、[[R&S RTO]] / [[R&S RTP]]、RT-ZHD07 voltage probe、RT-ZC31 current probe。
- Slide 18 提到 measurement-driven development of energy-saving amplifiers、envelope signal for tracker generated in real-time、turnkey solution based on VSG + VSA + SW、dedicated SW applications for Doherty、[[R&S SMW-K546]] 與 [[R&S FSW-K18]]。
- Slide 19 提出 PA load-pull testing，用於確認 PA 在 final design 看到不同 impedance 時的 behavior。

Data center full-spectrum connectivity
[[Data center full-spectrum connectivity]] 是 [[full-spectrum-data-center-connectivity-brochure]] 呈現的 portfolio 視角：把 AI / data center 的 high-speed electrical interconnect、optical interconnect、fiber deployment、rack power distribution、busbar、liquid cooling 與 leak detection 放在同一張 data center connectivity brochure 中。

Data center full-spectrum connectivity › Optical 與 fiber connectivity
- [[Amphenol XPO-LPO]] — 來源稱其以 224 Gb/s per lane across 64 channels，面向 AI scale-up deployments。
- [[1.6T OSFP Transceivers]] — 來源稱 Amphenol 200G/lane optical modules support DR4、FR4、2×DR4、2×FR4、AOC、breakout AOC configurations with LC or MPO ports。
- [[Amphenol Co-packaged Optics]] — 來源稱 Amphenol offers an architecture from high-density electrical interposer to linear optical conversion module to fiber plant。
- [[LEAP On-Board Transceiver]] — 來源稱其為 12-channel duplex optical transceiver，up to 25Gbps per channel，300Gbps cumulative on multi-mode fiber。
- [[300G CXP2 Active Optical Cable]] — 來源稱 CXP2 to CXP2 AOC provides cost-effective plug and play cabling solution，delivers high hardware faceplate port density among existing SFF industry standards。
- [[CommScope Rapid Fiber Connect Platform]] — 來源稱其 simplifies and accelerates AI scaling by pre-integrating optics off-site and reducing on-site fiber connections。

R&S SMCV100B › Baseband enhancements
| Code | Name / description | Order No. | 相依關係／限制 |
|---|---|---|---|

| `R&S®SMCVB-K548` | Crest factor reduction | `1434.5640.02` | 原文未標示 requires/excludes。 |

R&S SMCV100B › Digital baseband input/output（`R&S®SMCVB-K19`）
- Digital baseband input/output 需 `R&S®SMCVB-K19` option；最多可安裝 `1` 個。
- Output mode 時可於儀器後面板提供 digital I/Q signals；外部 digital I/Q signals 可經 dedicated connector 輸入 baseband section。
- 可用於 [[R&S SMCV100B]] 與其他 Rohde & Schwarz 儀器的 digital I/Q input/output lossless connection，例如 [[R&S SMW200A]]。
- Interface standard：`Dig. I/Q HS`，符合 `R&S®Digital I/Q interface 40G (DIG I/Q 40G)`，包含 I/Q data and control signals。

- Digital baseband input sample rate：`400 Hz to 300 MHz`，maximum sample rate depends on connected transmitting device。
- I/Q data：output up to `16 bit`，input `16 bit`，two’s complement；RF bandwidth `0.8 × sample rate`；control signals `2 markers`。

SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100 › I/Q、baseband 與 digital I/Q
- Internal baseband I/Q、wideband baseband `R&S®SMW-B13XT`、I/Q wideband on：`f > 2.5 GHz` 時 `±1 GHz`；RF modulation bandwidth 可達 `2 GHz`。
- Internal baseband I/Q、standard baseband `R&S®SMW-B13/-B13T`、I/Q wideband on：`1 MHz < f ≤ 250 MHz` 時 `±32 % of carrier frequency`，`f > 250 MHz` 時 `±80 MHz`。
- Standard baseband generator `R&S®SMW-B10` arbitrary waveform mode：waveform length `1 sample to 64 Msample`，with `R&S®SMW-K511` 到 `512 Msample`，with `R&S®SMW-K512` 到 `1 Gsample`；sample rate `400 Hz to 150 MHz`，with `R&S®SMW-K522` 到 `200 MHz`；RF bandwidth 到 `120 MHz` 或 `160 MHz`。
- Wideband baseband generator `R&S®SMW-B9` arbitrary waveform mode：waveform length `1 sample to 256 Msample`，with `R&S®SMW-K515` 到 `2 Gsample`；sample rate `400 Hz to 600 MHz`，with `R&S®SMW-K525` 到 `1200 MHz`，with `R&S®SMW-K527` 到 `2400 MHz`；RF bandwidth 到 `500 MHz`、`1000 MHz`、`2000 MHz`。
- Standard digital baseband outputs 至少需 `R&S®SMW-K18`；wideband digital baseband outputs 至少需 `R&S®SMW-K19`。
- DIG I/Q interface 符合 `R&S®Digital I/Q Interface PAD-R`，connector `26-pin MDR`；HS DIG I/Q 符合 `R&S®Digital I/Q Interface 40G PAD-R`，connector `QSFP+/QSFP 28`。

SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100 › Spectral purity 與 phase noise
- Harmonics 規格適用於 CW、`f > 1 MHz`，依 frequency option 與 level 條件可為 `< –30 dBc` 或在較高頻段 `< –55 dBc`。

- Standard performance SSB phase noise 條件：CW、carrier offset `20 kHz`、measurement bandwidth `1 Hz`、level `10 dBm` 或 maximum specified output power 兩者較低者。
- Standard performance at `f = 1 GHz`：`< –134 dBc`，typ. `–140 dBc`。
- `R&S®SMW-B711/-B721` ultra low phase noise at `f = 1 GHz`、`10 kHz offset`：`–144 dBc`，typ. `–150 dBc`；at `f = 67 GHz`、`10 kHz offset`：`–105 dBc`，typ. `–111 dBc`。
